依据／否决原因: 源“Check Product Availability”与目标“Shopping Cart Creation Function”都取自原文 FR-12 同一义务，属于自指；且 FR-12 已写明“checks product availability”，参考基准 1.21 只是细化（商品存在性、数量、库存）而非新增义务。
源目标同出原文 FR-02：“validates the credentials”与 Output“redirected to their personalized dashboard”构成输入-输出依赖；但原文 FR-02 只规定认证成功路径，参考基准 1.2 明确补上“登录失败不得建立会话或展示个性化内容、须给出清晰错误反馈并重定向登录页/首页”这一失败处理义务。

原文 FR-20 明确“Administrators can check the system's interface for compliance… A compliance report is generated and displayed to the administrator. Non-compliant elements are highlighted.”，报告生成、展示与高亮均已在原文规定，参考基准 1.43 未新增义务。
源 Order Cancellation 与目标 Cancellation Event Recorded 同出原文 FR-33，Output 行写明“The cancellation event is recorded in the Purchase History data entity”，事件记录义务已覆盖。
源 Shopping Cart Creation Function 与目标 Product Added to Shopping Cart 同出原文 FR-12，Output 行写明“The product is added to the Shopping Cart data entity”，加购结果义务已覆盖。

源 Customer Registration Function 与目标 Customer Account Created 同出原文 FR-01，Output 行写明“A new customer account is created and stored in the Personal Information and Contact Information data entities”，建账义务已覆盖。
源 Order Confirmation Email Sending Function 与目标 Confirmation Event 同出原文 FR-16，Output 行写明“The confirmation event is recorded in the Purchase History data entity”，事件记录义务已覆盖。

源“Check Product Availability”与目标“Inventory Quantity Updated”同出原文 FR-12 同一义务（自指），并非两项义务间的依赖；且 FR-12 已写明“checks product availability and updates inventory”。
源 Product Addition Function 与目标 Product Data Entity 同出原文 FR-07 同一义务（自指）；FR-07 的 Output 行已写明“A new product is stored in the Product data entity, associated with the selected category”。

源“Check Product Availability”与目标“Confirmation Message Shown”同出原文 FR-12 同一义务（自指）；FR-12 的 Output 行已写明“The customer is shown a confirmation message”。
